sloka: यथागारं दृढस्थूणं जीर्णं भूत्वा ऽवसीदति ।तथैव सीदन्ति नरा जरामृत्युवशङ्गता: ॥ २.१०५.१८॥
transliteration: yathāgāraṁ dṛḍhasthūṇaṁ jīrṇaṁ bhūtvā 'vasīdati ।tathaiva sīdanti narā jarāmṛtyuvaśaṅgatā: ॥ 2.105.18॥

translations.english: Even a house constructed with sturdy pillars gets dilapidated and ultimately decays. In the same way people under the sway of old age and death are destroyed (at last).
